activity_statements.statement: delivers comprehensive clinical care from routine to complex cases across an integrated network of academic medical centers, community hospitals, and health centers throughout New England
conducts $2.7 billion in annual biomedical research activities with thousands of researchers and clinical trials advancing treatments and therapies
trains 2,000+ physician residents and fellows annually across 100+ accredited programs in partnership with Harvard Medical School
operates 5 licensed and 15 affiliated community health centers investing $225M+ annually in community health benefits
includes Massachusetts General Hospital, Brigham and Women's Hospital, McLean Hospital, and other member and affiliate institutions across New England

name_reality_gap: none - Mass General Brigham accurately signals an academic health system. The 'Hospitals & Health Care' index label is accurate though it underrepresents the scale of the research enterprise ($2.7B annually) and physician training pipeline.
extraction_notes: About page was comprehensive with specific figures on research spend, training programs, community investment, and historical firsts. Strong source.
